stable.title: DroidDeck 0.5.0
stable.summary: • Added SteamVR on Meta Quest 3 and 3S from the standard APK. Quest headsets are detected automatically and get their own driver defaults. Immersive SteamVR runs through a native OpenXR activity with headset tracking, Touch controllers and haptics, and SteamVR's dashboard and Steam library work in VR. (@xXJSONDeruloXx, @Jagger15, #642, #910, #733, #853, #905)

preview.title: fix: install Decky Loader from upstream repository
preview.summary: • Point the Decky Loader release lookup at SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader instead of the Droid-Deck/decky-loader fork. Upstream now publishes the PluginLoader-arm64 asset that DroidDeck downloads.

recentPreviews.title: fix: install Decky Loader from upstream repository
recentPreviews.summary: • Point the Decky Loader release lookup at SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader instead of the Droid-Deck/decky-loader fork. Upstream now publishes the PluginLoader-arm64 asset that DroidDeck downloads.

recentPreviews.title: fix: keep second-screen controls in their own activity
recentPreviews.summary: Thor can kill a running Steam game when its bottom-screen controls are open: the controls are a Presentation dialog, leaving Android's launcher as the resumed activity on that display. A reproduced launcher restart changed DroidDeck to oomscoreadj +50, followed by an LMKD kill. A DroidDeck activity on the second display preserved priority 0 and allowed the same memory profile to load Elden Ring'

recentPreviews.title: feat: auto driver picks come from a Drivers-CI manifest with per-GPU fallbacks
recentPreviews.summary: Step 3 of the Auto driver plan: Auto's pick per GPU now comes from a manifest in Drivers-CI, so the team can change a default or pull a bad build without an app release.

recentPreviews.title: fix: skip DirectAudio setup for Proton queries
recentPreviews.summary: Steam asks Proton tools to translate paths while preparing a launch. Those queries currently stage DirectAudio and overwrite a prefix's Audio choice, which can reset a Pulse selection before the game runs. Limit DirectAudio setup to run, waitforexitandrun and runinprefix.

recentPreviews.title: chore: bump version to 0.5.0 (14)
recentPreviews.summary: Bumps versionCode to 14 and versionName to 0.5.0 for the 0.5.0 release.

recentPreviews.title: fix: only start SteamVR for VR-only games from Steam's library
recentPreviews.summary: A user reported that No Man's Sky kept starting SteamVR and opening in VR without VR mode selected. It still happened after they uninstalled SteamVR in Steam, cleared DroidDeck's data and reinstalled it. Steam kept showing SteamVR's Install button the whole time.

recentPreviews.title: feat: fetch Proton, FEX and the runtimes automatically, and make Linux games run under FEX
recentPreviews.summary: Proton Experimental ARM64, FEX and the Steam Linux Runtimes now download automatically on the first Steam start. Linux games running under FEX start, stay up and take the controller.

recentPreviews.title: Add app-wide 3DoF for VITURE, RayNeo and XREAL glasses and 6DoF for Luma Ultra
recentPreviews.summary: Smart-glasses screen tracking now applies throughout DroidDeck: its menus and settings, non-Steam launchers, desktop sessions, and games share the same configuration. Users can select a tracked virtual screen without starting SteamVR. The branch also adds Luma Ultra positional tracking and optional stereo-assisted controllers, improves glasses display routing, and hardens SteamVR startup and rende

recentPreviews.title: feat: x86-64 client follows DroidDeck-Components' fex.json; fuller x86-64 session logs
recentPreviews.summary: FEX builds can now reach devices without an app release, and x86-64 session logs say more about what ran.

recentPreviews.title: fix: x86-64 Steam client fails without the KDE desktop (FEX r5 bundles libxxhash)
recentPreviews.summary: The x86-64 Steam client failed at its first FEX call on devices without the KDE desktop package:

tests.title: Fix direct-touch right-click and Steam Touch mode restoration
tests.summary: Addresses #628 by adding long-press right-click to Direct Touch (including Steam Touch’s direct mode) and restoring the saved touch mode when Steam Touch is disabled; all 10 focused tests pass, with device validation pending.

tests.title: fix: install Decky from upstream and offer the newest release
tests.summary:
• Install and update the Decky Loader from SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader instead of the Droid-Deck/decky-loader fork. Upstream now publishes the PluginLoader-arm64 build that DroidDeck downloads, so the fork is no longer needed.
• Offer the newest release across the stable and prerelease channels. Previously the menu showed stable and only fell back to prerelease when no stable release existed.

tests.title: fix: an interrupted package install can no longer break the Linux runtime
tests.summary: A tester's Thor stopped starting Steam (Exit status 134) after the app was closed during a desktop install. Restarting did not help; only reinstalling the app did, which cost them every game.

tests.title: feat: Better boot movies system; Added steamdeckrepo support
tests.summary:
• Installed: the “Installed movies” row has a Browse button. It opens a list with a cover for each movie and the current one highlighted. The list re-reads every 2 seconds, so a movie picked or removed inside Steam shows up.
• Import: the same import as before. Imported movies now go into Steam’s own movies folder, so Steam lists them too.
• SteamDeckRepo: search, device filter (all, Steam Deck, Steam Machine), and Trending / Most downloaded / Most liked / Newest tabs. Each page shows 12 movies, with Previous and Next buttons. Install downloads the movie, and the button turns into Use.
• Sound: the on/off toggle, plus a volume slider and a “Length” slider. I read your “seconds slide” as how many seconds of the movie play, from 1 s up to the movie’s full length. Tell me if you meant something else.
• The Adjust logo hint now reads “This exact spot can differ by a few pixels.”

tests.summary: Unit tests on main and on open PRs fail with java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space part way through testReleaseUnitTest. Examples: the main push run 39156692801, #979, and the fix/touch-gestures-628, fix/dex-session-visibility and fix/skip-directaudio-for-steam-iscript branches. The test that fails changes from run to run (SteamHomeHeadsetTest, GlassesMenuCaptureTest, ...), and

tests.title: fix: run x86 Proton under FEX in the Steam runtime it requires
tests.summary: x86-64 Proton (e.g. Proton Experimental / 11) run through droiddeck-fex never got past startup on the Thor. Three separate problems, all in the FEX launch path:

tests.title: feat: opt-in offline launch for Easy Anti-Cheat games
tests.summary: Adds an opt-in per-game DROIDDECKANTICHEATOFFLINE setting. For Proton launches, it reads the executable from the adjacent EasyAntiCheat/settings.json and launches that executable directly, allowing games with an offline mode to start without the EAC bootstrapper. Game and anti-cheat files remain untouched; online modes requiring EAC remain unavailable.

tests.title: fix: ignore uinput- system virtual input devices in controller detection
tests.summary: Ignore kernel uinput- / uinput virtual input devices in PadBridge so vendor virtual input nodes (such as uinput-xiaomi on Xiaomi HyperOS 3) do not claim Player 1 (slot 0) or keep anyControllerConnected() permanently true.

tests.title: Keep visible external-display sessions running
tests.summary: Use the session Activity’s display power when suspending or resuming, preventing handset screen-off from pausing visible DeX sessions (#586, #741); Android 26/28/29/33 regressions and CI pass, and the signed build passed Thor secondary-display visibility and sleep/wake checks, with Samsung hardware validation pending.

tests.title: feat: target Android API 36
tests.summary: Moves the app from targetSdk 28 to targetSdk 36 (compileSdk 34 → 36).

tests.title: fix(session): prevent overlapping startup and teardown
tests.summary: Users reported Steam appearing offline. Logs showed Session Replaced after successful sign-in, while downloads still worked. This PR prevents overlapping local sessions, one possible cause, but does not establish the cause of those reports.

tests.title: Steam client download: resumes, retries, shows megabytes, and isn't paused out of sight
tests.summary: A user's first Steam setup never finished on an Honor Pad (Snapdragon 6 Gen 1, metered Wi-Fi with a 14 Mbit/s link). Their log stops at downloading Steam: binslinuxarm64linuxarm64 (2/17). The log was shared 31 s into the session, so nothing had failed yet. The way the download works explains why it never got further.

tests.title: Accessibility tab: install and enable Orca in every Linux session
tests.summary: Adds an Accessibility tab to the launcher's front-end rail: an introduction to Orca (the GNOME screen reader), an install button, an open-settings button and a master switch that defaults on after install.

tests.title: Rumble: reliable controller motors, Deck haptics, optional Razer Kishi USB rumble; Kishi L4/R4 as Deck back grips
tests.summary: ﻿Fixes the rumble part of #219 / follow-up to #242. Reported in the DroidDeck Discord #bug-reports forum (Kishi V3 Pro on a Galaxy S26 Ultra), with logs there.

tests.title: Return to the launcher when a front-end game closes
tests.summary: When a game started from DroidDeck's Games tab (or from another launcher's link) closes, DroidDeck now ends the Steam session cleanly and takes you back to where you launched it, instead of leaving you in Big Picture.
